programme.title: Kickboxer 2: O Regresso
programme.desc: Um ano depois de Kurt Sloane derrotar Tong Po no torneio de kickboxing, o seu irmão David Sloane, que se esforça para manter à tona uma academia de kickboxing em Los Angeles, é forçado a entrar no ringue para uma luta de desforra contra Po.

programme.title: Kickboxer III
programme.desc: David Sloane viaja para o Rio de Janeiro para um evento de kickboxing, onde acaba por salvar dois jovens e enfrentar um traficante de esclavos.

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Força Maior
programme.desc: Uma família sueca goza umas férias num resort dos Alpes Franceses, mas uma avalanche vai provocar o caos durante o almoço num restaurante na montanha, e as reações instintivas do casal vão causar uma fissura que pode provocar o fim da relação.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: Rebobina E Ressaca
programme.desc: Um casal entra em crise quando a mulher, uma ´supermãe´ subestimada e em stress, sofre um colapso pós-traumático durante as festas de fim de ano que a leva a retomar a personalidade desvairada que tinha quando estava na universidade.

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Em 1927, a visita do Rei e da Rainha de Inglaterra à casa da família Crawley, vai lançar a confusão na propriedade de Downton Abbey, tanto entre os nobres como na criadagem.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: Uma Nova Era
programme.desc: Os aristocratas da família Crawley deixam Downton Abbey e partem em viagem ao sul de França para descobrir o mistério da “villa” herdada pela Condessa de Grantham.

programme.title: Sempre
programme.desc: Pete Sandich é um piloto com paixão pelo desafio, mas Dorinda, a mulher que ele ama, e Al, o seu melhor amigo, sabem que as lendas não podem correr riscos para sempre. Depois de se ter sacrificado para salvar Al, Pete enfrenta a sua missão mais difícil: ajudar Dorinda a seguir em frente.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: Uma pequena equipa de elite de oficiais americanos, parte de uma unidade operações especiais e secretas, tem por missão levar para fora da Indonésia um misterioso agente da polícia com informações sensíveis.

programme.title: Covil De Ladrões
programme.desc: A unidade de elite de combate ao crime de Los Angeles, que nem sempre joga pelas regras, entra em confronto com o gangue de assalto a bancos mais bem sucedido da cidade. Quando os fora-da-lei decidem assaltar a Reserva Federal, qual dos dois se revelará o mais implacável?

programme.title: Fora de Controlo
programme.desc: Thomas Craven é um veterano da polícia que investiga o homicídio da própria filha, na sequência do qual descobre uma conspiração empresarial e governamental de proporções inesperadas.

programme.title: Gémeos
programme.desc: Um homem inocente mas fisicamente perfeito vai em busca do irmão gémeo, que afinal é um vigarista careca e de pequena estatura.

programme.title: The Contractor: Mercenário
programme.desc: Após ser dispensado das Forças Especiais do Exército e perder a pensão e o seguro de saúde, James Harper, endividado e com a família para sustentar, assina contrato com a uma equipa militar privada. Só que quando primeira missão corre mal, ele torna-se um alvo a abater.

programme.title: Vem Ao Papá
programme.desc: Após receber uma carta enigmática do seu pai, que não vê desde os cinco anos, Norval viaja para ir ter com ele, na esperança de que esta seja uma oportunidade para se reaproximarem. Mas será que se ele soubesse a verdade sombria sobre o seu progenitor, ele o teria reencontrado?

programme.title: Wilde
programme.desc: A história de Oscar Wilde, o genial poeta e dramaturgo, que vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando percebe que é homossexual.

programme.title: Sin City: Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: É Demais Para Mim
programme.desc: Mesmo tendo com uma doença que lhe deixará pouco tempo de vida, Marta é uma menina órfã e alegre que decide encontrar alguém que se apaixone por ela. E quando conhece Arturo numa festa, é amor à primeira vista. Mas nem tudo vai correr como ela espera…

programme.title: Bernie, O Golfinho
programme.desc: Na Florida, dois irmãos encontram um golfinho separado da família e com queimaduras solares que acabam por ajudar, mas acabam também por descobrir um plano que pode destruir a praia e o lar do seu novo amigo.

programme.title: Bernie, O Golfinho 2
programme.desc: Kevin e Holly estão muito felizes por o golfinho Bernie estar de volta. Só que o seu velho inimigo Winston também está de regresso e quer raptar o inteligente cetáceo, o que vai obrigar os dois irmãos a fazerem de tudo para o salvar.

programme.title: O Pequeno Vampiro
programme.desc: Rudolph é um vampiro de 13 anos cujo clã é ameaçado por um reputado caçador de sugadores de sangue. Felizmente, ele conhece um humano da mesma idade, que o vai ajudar na sua luta de convencer os humanos e os vampiros a deixarem para trás os preconceitos e a trabalharem juntos.

programme.title: Pára, Ou A Mamã Dispara!
programme.desc: Joe Bornowski, sargento da polícia de Los Angeles, vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando a sua adorável mãe chega à cidade para uma curta visita, testemunha um crime e envolve-se de tal maneira numa perigosa investigação policial que acaba por se tornar na sua parceira.

programme.title: Para Roma Com Amor
programme.desc: Um casal em lua de mel, um arquiteto que regressa à rua onde viveu em estudante, um homem que se torna uma celebridade da noite para o dia e um diretor funerário tenta cumprir o sonho de ser cantor de ópera: quatro histórias que se cruzam na gloriosa cidade de Roma.

programme.title: Gémeos
programme.desc: Um homem inocente mas fisicamente perfeito vai em busca do irmão gémeo, que afinal é um vigarista careca e de pequena estatura.

programme.title: O Melhor Homem
programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários toma o controlo do hotel de um resort remoto durante um casamento e cabe ao padrinho, ao noivo e ao seu melhor amigo bêbado tentarem deter os terroristas e salvar os reféns.

Quando uma arma ultrassecreta cai em mãos erradas, a agente da CIA Mason “Mace” Brown terá de unir forças com a sua rival Marie, com a antiga aliada do MI6 Khadijah e ainda com a hábil psicóloga colombiana Graciela, numa perigosa missão na qual terão de enfrentar a misteriosa Lin Mi Sheng.

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: Quando Joe Braven se vê confrontado com um grupo de perigosos traficantes de droga na sua cabana isolada nas montanhas, ele vai ter de fazer tudo o que estiver ao seu alcance para proteger a sua família.

programme.title: Zona De Perigo
programme.desc: Abby Trent é uma agente da CIA que gere uma prisão clandestina de alto risco. Quando capturam Hatchet, o homem mais perigoso do mundo e um mestre na arte da fuga, ele inicia um jogo sangrento, eliminando os oficiais um a um. Abby descobre que está rodeada de traidores. Em quem pode confiar?

programme.title: A Quadrilha Selvagem
programme.desc: Em 1913, na fronteira entre os EUA e o México, um grupo de foras-da-lei de idade avançada procura fazer um último golpe e percebe que todo o mundo em que viveram, o do velho Oeste, está a mudar e desaparecer à sua volta.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw 2018
programme.desc: Musical critics from North America, Europe, and Russia praise Nalchik-born pianist Misha Fomin for his subtlety of touch and phrasing. He graduated cum laude from the Gnessin’s Russian Academy of Music, Moscow, where he studied with Lina Bulatova, a former student of professor Helen Gnessina and legendary Heinrich Neuhaus, and later continued his musical studies at the Hochschule für Musik “Franz Liszt” in Weimar.

programme.title: Gala from Berlin - 2011
programme.desc: This year the Berlin Philharmonic and their musical director Sir Simon Rattle welcome the New Year together with multi-awarded Russian pianist Evgeny Kissin. Kissin's musicality, the depth and poetic quality of his interpretations, and his extraordinary virtuosity have placed him at the forefront of today's pianists. This concert he will feature as star soloist in a performance of Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2007 - Berlin
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 39, K. 543
programme.desc: David Zinman conducts the Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s (1756-1791) Symphony No. 39, K. 543. Recorded in the Sophiensaal in Munich in 1991 and directed by János Darvas. The work is the first in a set of three which became Mozart’s last symphonies. The set was composed in rapid succession in the summer of 1788. The first movement opens with a majestic introduction with fanfares heard in the brass section.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 4, Op. 52
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda performs Frédéric Chopin's technically challenging Ballade No. 4 in F minor, Op. 52. Completed in 1842, this piece is celebrated as a masterpiece within the Romantic piano repertoire, renowned for its intricate structure and profound emotional depth. This performance was recorded at the stunning baroque palace Villa Contarini in Piazzola sul Brenta, Italy, in 2006.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: The Orchestra Mozart, founded in 2004, is supposed to give young, talented musicians a possibility to play in a world-class orchestra being conducted by one of the outstanding conductors of our time. Claudio Abbado, the artistic director, is responsible for its profile, inviting musicians and chamber ensembles of international reputation.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the first/third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Cello: Busoni, Liszt, Chopin And Rachmaninoff
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni’s Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong; Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano; Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3; and Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Brahms - Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in a wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Tedi Papavrami, violist Lyda Chen-Argerich, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed 'Farewell' because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas.

programme.title: The Violin in Naples - Matteis and Guido
programme.desc: “No mortal ever played the violin better than Signor Nichola.” The English rubbed their eyes in disbelief when in the late 17th century Nicola Matteis demonstrated his superior playing. Josef Žák, Czech and violin prodigy of the latest generation, has selected three suites from Matteis’ Ayres for violin and basso continuo.

programme.title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 16, Op. 135
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: Maestro Jaap van Zweden conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 in D minor, Op. 47. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, on March 9, 2016.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61. Leading violinist Grimal is the soloist.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1994 – Meiningen
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Italian conductor Beatrice Venezi leads the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est and the Choeur de l'Opéra-Théâtre de Metz Métropole in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s tragic opera Madama Butterfly (1904). The story revolves around Cio-Cio-San, the young Japanese geisha ‘Butterfly’ who marries the visiting American officer Pinkerton. Faithfully awaiting his return, she cannot accept that Pinkerton has abandoned her.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 17, K 453
programme.desc: This performance of Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 17, K 453 was recorded at the Imperial Schönbrunn Palace in Vienna and features soloist Dezsö Ránki and the English Chamber Orchestra, conducted by JeffreyTate.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Jeu de cartes
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 100
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers.

programme.title: Liszt - Totentanz, S. 525
programme.desc: Russian pianist Dina Ivanova performs Franz Liszt’s Totentanz, S. 525, during the Solo finals of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held at TivoliVredenburg in Utrecht, the Netherlands. Totentanz (Dance of Death) is one of Liszt’s many works that reflect the Romantic composer’s fascination with death. The piece is a series of variations on the macabre Gregorian Dies irae theme.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Passion in premiere - Giovanni Maria Trabaci
programme.desc: A first: an Early Baroque passion which will be heard again for the first time in the modern age. Giovanni Maria Trabaci was a style pioneer who broke with the Neapolitan unison tradition and was the first composer to write a complete passion cycle. With Jean-Marc Aymes’s unerring nose for quality, this concert belongs at the top of your list of favourites.

programme.title: Testing Mozart
programme.desc: Testing Mozart is a 60 minute film about the Mozart effect; the power of Mozart's music to fight disease and increase the mental ability of listeners. It is common knowledge that cows give more milk and tomatoes grow bigger when Mozart is played, but what effect does his music have on humans?

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61
programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker at the Easter Festival in Baden-Baden, 2015. On the program is Ludwig van Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Op. 61. The award-winning Isabelle Faust is the soloist, and since her recordings with Claudio Abbado, she’s the first choice when it comes to this masterpiece.

programme.title: Bach - Preludes and Fugues And Alla variata BWV 989
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In this recital, Bacchetti performs works of J. S. Bach.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Verdi - Otello
programme.desc: Based on a story by William Shakespeare, the Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi wrote the opera Otello. Stage director David Alden created his version of this tragedy for the Teatro Real, in Madrid. Renato Palumbo conducts the orchestra and chorus of the Teatro Real. The performance also features Gregory Kunde, Ermonela Jaho, and George Petean. Othello, the Venetian governor of Cyprus, returns to the island after a victorious campaign.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a 'Concerto for piano without orchestra', in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 5, Op. 64
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Concerto
programme.desc: Israeli violinist Itzhak Perlman and the Berlin Philharmonic perform Johannes Brahms' Violin Concerto (1833-1897) under the direction of Daniel Barenboim. After Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Brahms' piece is probably the most famous German Violin Concerto ever written. These two works have much in common, especially the tone in D major in which they were composed.

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace I
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads his Ensemble BIOS in a performance of ‘Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), I’, by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda. This piece is written for strings and tar, a traditional plucked string instrument of Persian music, played here by Saeed Mirzazadeh. Ensemble BIOS specializes in 20th and 21st century music.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Violin Concerto, Op. 64
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in the 2016 edition of the Europakonzert. This time, it takes place at the beautiful Baroque church of Røros, a Norwegian mining town whose intact picturesque old town makes it a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The talented Norwegian violinist Vilde Frang is the star soloist in Mendelssohn’s songful Violin Concerto, Op. 64, which she plays with warmth, elegance and effortless virtuosity.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Mozart Live from Beijing
programme.desc: On January 27, 2006, Chinese virtuoso pianist Lang Lang celebrated WA Mozart's birthday with a performance of the Piano Concerto No. 24 in the Forbidden City Concert Hall of Beijing with the China Philharmonic Orchestram directed by Long Yu. The concert hall is located inside the walls of the Forbidden City, in the beautifully maintained gardens of Zhongshan Park, directly adjacent to Tiananmen Square.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: Ultraje: Traje Da Festa Dos Tabuleiros - Tomar
programme.desc: “Ultraje” é uma viagem vibrante pelo coração da identidade portuguesa. Em cada episódio, percorremos o país para descobrir os trajes típicos que contam histórias de outras gerações, mergulhando nas tradições, costumes e festas que lhes dão vida. Mais do que roupa, são símbolos de orgulho, resistência e pertença — preservados por homens e mulheres que mantêm viva a memória coletiva.

programme.title: De Gente And De Vinha: A Vinha De Enforcado Nos Vinhos Verdes
programme.desc: De Gente And De Vinha, um retrato intimista do mundo vitivinícola, apresentado com o requinte e poesia do chef André Magalhães, percorre conversas e deambulações por entre quintas familiares, castas em extinção, tabernas e adegas centenárias.Dos lameiros férteis do Minho, a vinha trepou às árvores, subiu às ramadas e transformou-se em paisagem. Em Mancelos, a vinha de enforcado ergue-se como memória viva de uma forma de cultivo antiga.

programme.title: Documentário: Chefe Do Ano 2026
programme.desc: Há 36 anos que a mesma pergunta atravessa as cozinhas de Portugal: quem é o Chefe do Ano? Mais do que um concurso, é o palco onde um sonho se transforma em legado, o mesmo que revelou nomes hoje incontornáveis na gastronomia portuguesa, todos eles, um dia, apenas cozinheiros e cozinheiras com uma faca, uma ideia e a coragem de arriscar tudo.

programme.title: A Letra: Paulo Gonzo - 'Jardins Proibidos'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas nas canções.A canção “Jardins Proibidos” foi lançada em 1992 no álbum Pedras da Calçada, o primeiro disco do artista inteiramente cantado em português. A canção, com música de Paulo Gonzo e Luís Oliveira e letra de Paulo Gonzo e Pedro Malaquias, tornou-se rapidamente um dos maiores êxitos da música portuguesa.

programme.title: Terror Na Torre Do Tubarão
programme.desc: Numa perigosa busca, Andy Casagrande, cineasta subaquático, e Kori Burkhardt, especialista em tubarões, tentam saber se tubarões brancos estão a migrar para a Carolina do Norte.

programme.title: Demónio Negro, O Tubarão
programme.desc: No México, há lendas de um tubarão de 15 metros que aterrorizou pescadores e turistas por gerações. Forrest Galante procura respostas na robusta e remota Península de Baja.

programme.title: Tubarão Autómata 2.0
programme.desc: O especialista em tubarões Kina Scollay e a equipa voltam com um submersível individual, o «Mechashark», à Nova Zelândia, onde detetam um local de acasalamento de tubarões brancos.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T10 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Um viciado em adrenalina e um parolo que se diz renascentista enfrentam sapos tóxicos e ferimentos graves na Colômbia. Será que duram os 21 dias?

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma velha construção está de regresso para novas personalizações e um novo nome. Com Kevin fora, Dave tenta introduzir um projeto pessoal.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T5 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Um cliente chega e pede a Dave para construir o que pensa que será um Hummer H2 daqui a 20 anos. É fora com o velho e que venha o novo!

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T16 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como objetos como pisa papéis de vidro, sal para as estradas, quebra nozes e portas do carro são feitos? Esta série analisa objetos do quotidiano.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T22 - Ep. 23
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano analisados ao microscópio para descobrirmos como são feitas as pedras de plasma e a neve de efeitos especiais.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T9 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Os mineiros de ouro do Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de fazerem fortuna. Com novos mineiros, novos terrenos e novas máquinas, a fasquia está mais alta do que nunca!

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T9 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Os mineiros de ouro do Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de fazerem fortuna. Com novos mineiros, novos terrenos e novas máquinas, a fasquia está mais alta do que nunca!

programme.title: Aquários XXL T6 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: O Imaginarium Science Center pede um aquário gigante em forma de navio com uma réplica so USCGC Mohawk lá dentro, o que prova ser uma grande dor de cabeça para ATM.

programme.title: Aquários XXL T6 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Wayde e Brett fazem um aquário para o famoso DJ Redfoo da banda LMFAO. Os rapazes tentam o seu primeiro aquário cabine de DJ.

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T9 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Temperaturas altas de verão levam os mineiros a encontrar novas estratégias. Shawn entra numa batalha legal, enquanto Emily e os Kelly procuram expandir a operação.

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T9 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Quando o verão aperta, Ken e o Myrtle Irene ficam presos na lama. Os Kelly são obrigados a socorrer e Shawn recebe notícias sobre o destino de Christine Rose.

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T9 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Shawn experiência pela primeira vez a mudança do leito do mar. Ken tenta uma nova abordagem para encontrar novos terrenos, enquanto Kris e Emily testam mergulhadores novatos.

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T9 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Os mineiros procuram terrenos mais valiosos. Shawn tem que lutar contra a mudança da maré, Ken esforça o braço da sua escavadora e o novo mergulhador Brian salva o dia de Vernon.

programme.title: Em Busca Do Pé Grande T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Uma equipa de especialistas, equipada com a mais recente tecnologia, tenta localizar o lendário Pé Grande («Bigfoot»). O início da sua busca leva-os às florestas do Oregon.

programme.title: Em Busca Do Pé Grande T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Com uma baixa na equipa, Russell e Mireya devem seguir em frente para descobrir pistas. As suas investigações revelam os primeiros potenciais sinais do Pé Grande («Bigfoot»).

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T16 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como são feitos os chouriços de sangue, os volantes e os pigmentos não orgânicos? Esta série analisa microscopicamente vários objetos do quotidiano.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T16 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como são feitos os tachos de ferro fundido, o biodiesel e os cabides? Esta série analisa microscopicamente vários objetos do quotidiano.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T22 - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano analisados ao microscópio para descobrirmos como são feitos as bicicletas elétricas de três rodas e o creme hidratante.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T22 - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano analisados ao microscópio para descobrirmos como são feitas os coldres do oeste e câmaras de água.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T22 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano analisados ao microscópio para descobrirmos como são feitas as portas de garagem de madeira e os dinossauros animatrónicos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T24 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Saiba como as máquinas de montagem, as tartes de limão e as figuras de guerra em miniatura são feitas.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T24 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Saiba como são feitas as ventilações para tanques de químicos, candy wafers, carrinhas de comida e cordas tradicionais.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T24 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Saiba como o grafeno, o carro mais pequeno do mundo, testes de força e compostos automóveis são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T16 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como são feitos os alfinetes e as agulhas, os moldes decorativos e as locomotivas? Esta série analisa microscopicamente vários objetos do quotidiano.

programme.title: Tubarões Da Ilha Fantasma
programme.desc: O ataque de um tubarão quase afundou o seu barco e o Dr. Craig O'Connell e a equipa voltam a uma ilha assombrada do Triângulo das Bermudas para saber por que atrai tantos tubarões.

programme.title: Novo Alerta, Tubarões
programme.desc: Enquanto o vórtice do tubarão recua no outono, os tubarões lutam pelo domínio nas águas geladas da Nova Inglaterra.

programme.title: Um Mundo De Tubarões-Anequins
programme.desc: Riley Elliot, especialista em tubarões e Andy Casagrande, operador de câmara, estão numa expedição épica para revelar os mistérios do tubarão-anequim, o maior predador do mar.

programme.title: Tubarões Brancos De Guadalupe T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Está na hora de mergulhar no oceano e de ficar frente a frente com um dos predadores mais mortais do mundo e explorar as suas vidas secretas.

programme.title: Semana Dos Tubarões: O Máximo T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Vamos mergulhar nas maiores emoções e nos momentos mais assustadores dos últimos 35 anos nos bastidores de momentos icónicos e imagens nunca antes vistas!

programme.title: Tubarão Da Florida: Sangue Na Água T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Paul de Gelder mergulha na capital mundial dos ataques de tubarões. Realiza experiências para perceber o que torna estas águas tão perigosas.

programme.title: Expedição X: Tubarões Atómicos T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A equipa investiga relatos perturbadores de tubarões mutantes violentos nas Ilhas Marshall, procurando saber se o passado nuclear é o responsável.

programme.title: Tubarão-Raposa: O Golpe Mortal
programme.desc: O Dr. Craig O'Connell e Aliah Banchik recorrem a tecnologia de ponta para filmar o golpe letal da cauda do tubarão-raposa nas Filipinas.

programme.title: Como Sobreviver Ao Ataque De Um Tubarão
programme.desc: O sobrevivente de um ataque de tubarão, Paul de Gelder, tenta o impensável: ser atacado de novo por um tubarão para saber como pode salvar vidas.

programme.title: Tubarão-Martelo Monstruoso: Instinto Assassino
programme.desc: Um especialista acredita que os tubarões-martelo podem atingir grandes dimensões ao caçar outros tubarões. Para isso, obtém amostras de tecido de alguns dos maiores tubarões.

programme.title: Air Jaws: A Última Fronteira T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os realizadores, Andy Casagrande e Jeff Kurr, procuram o segundo tubarão-branco que realiza o maior salto para revelar segredos que fazem história nas águas da Nova Zelândia.

programme.title: Tubarão Polvo De Andros Island
programme.desc: Investigadores de tubarões dirigem-se até Andros Island para confirmar se aí o tubarão-martelo é visto. Uma criatura meio polvo, meio tubarão ajuda-os a localizar tubarões enormes.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele T10 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Neste desafio só de mulheres, 2 sobreviventes veteranas voltam para orientar 2 novas no perigo de San José Del Guaviare, na Colômbia, durante 21 dias.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T5 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Um dos designs favoritos de Dave é o Mercedes Gul-Wing, e um cliente tem a versão kit. Mas têm muitas falhas que precisam de atenção.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T16 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como são feitos a filigrana, a comida de peixe e as autocaravanas? Esta série analisa microscopicamente vários objetos do quotidiano.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T24 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Saiba como lâmpadas LED , barras de chocolate e manteiga de amendoim e dispensadores robóticos de medicamentos são feitos.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T9 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Os mineiros de ouro do Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de fazerem fortuna. Com novos mineiros, novos terrenos e novas máquinas, a fasquia está mais alta do que nunca!

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T9 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Os mineiros de ouro do Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de fazerem fortuna. Com novos mineiros, novos terrenos e novas máquinas, a fasquia está mais alta do que nunca!

programme.title: Aquários XXL T6 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Siga as aventuras de parceiros de negócio, melhores amigos e rivais Wayne King e Brett Raymer, enquanto gerem a maior empresa de aquários dos EUA, a Acrylic Tank Manufacturing.

programme.title: Aquários XXL T6 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: O famoso DJ Steve Aoki quer um um dragão de três cabeças prestes a escapar do seu aquário. Os rapazes devem assegurar-se de que este trabalho é tão extravagante quanto o DJ.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T8 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No meio da época, tanto os homens como as máquinas mostram sinais de desgaste. O Ramblin' Rose luta contra problemas no motor, enquanto o recruta do Wizard tem dúvidas.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T8 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A tripulação do Wizard enfrenta uma situação de vida ou de morte quando um ajudante desmaia. No Seabrooke, Scott está determinado a vencer a aposta do comandante, mas a que custo?

programme.title: Pesca Radical T8 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Numa tentativa de ajudar o seu recruta, a tripulação do Wizard chama o helicóptero da Guarda Costeira. O resto da frota apressa-se a apanhar caranguejos antes que o furacão ataque.

programme.title: Pesca Radical T8 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Um traiçoeiro furacão do Ártico dizima o mar, forçando os comandantes Elliot Neese e Scott Campbell Jr. a tomar algumas das decisões mais difíceis até à data.

programme.title: Em Busca Do Pé Grande T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Russell encontra uma estrutura que acha ser o refúgio do Pé Grande («Bigfoot»). Entretanto, o novo membro da equipa, Ronny vai com Mireya ao refúgio para recolher amostras de ADN.

programme.title: Em Busca Do Pé Grande T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Mireya e Ronny fazem uma surpreendente descoberta na área à volta do refúgio. Bryce suspeita que o Pé Grande («Bigfoot») emite infrassons para afastar a equipa do seu território.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 58
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 54
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 92
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 31
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 31
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 88
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024 jazzahead! focused on the Netherlands with over 40 artists preforming over the course of three days.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Linus
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Al Jarreau - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Great Guitarists - Collage
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Benjamin Herman - Sonny Rollins
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Wolfert Brederode
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Jacob Karlzon Trio - Open Waters
programme.desc: Swedish pianist Jacob Karlzon is joined by Danish bassist Morten Ramsbøl and Swedish drummer Rasmus Kihlberg at the Steinway piano factory in Hamburg to present their album ‘Open Waters’. Karlzon, a classically trained pianist who shared a stage with Kenny Wheeler, Norma Winstone, and Billy Cobham keeps the rich tradition of Swedish jazz eclecticism alive.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jacques Kuba Séguin: L'étude des Lueurs
programme.desc: Trumpeter Jacques Kuba Séguin’s ensemble unites some of Montreal’s most expressive musicians: apart from Jacques Kuba Séguin, double bassist Frédéric Alarie, pianist Jonathan Cayer, and drummer Kevin Warren deliver subtle but strong lyrical moments, that make it hard not to be touched by the musical bond of this group. The experience of their ‘Litania Projekt’ seems to stop time for an instant.

programme.title: The New Conrad Miller Trio Live at Mocher's
programme.desc: Full-time pianist, composer, teacher, and producer Coen Molenaar – aka Conrad Miller – is active all over the world in styles ranging as widely as jazz, fusion, dance, funk, RAndB, rock, and neo-soul. In this 2021 performance from Rossini Studios in Stuttgart, Germany, Miller plays contemporary trio jazz with his bandmates David de Marez Oyens (double bass) and Enrique Firpi (drums).

programme.title: BIRDtv: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Morgenland Festival: One Way Ticket to Damascus
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Vishten - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Frédéric Gassita And Les Solistes Francais
programme.desc: Frédéric Gassita’s biggest influences are Ravel and Debussy, Chick Corea, and Herbie Hancock – whom he met as a student in Boston. His work combines his African roots, rhythms, and orchestral music. Gassita's interest for orchestrations started at the Berklee College in Boston, where he studied music production, sound engineering, and jazz performance for four years. Today, he’s conquering Africa with his music style.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: A$AP Rocky And A$AP Ferg - At The Hordern Pavilion
programme.desc: Big hits, booty dancing, stage dives, fan freestyles and of course, controversy, A$AP Rocky's debut Down Under tour had it all! At his sold-out Sydney show, hip hop's hottest star and 5000 rowdy fans got wild for the night at the Hordern Pavilion and we captured it all exclusively.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan 'The Divine One' in 1958
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Libérica Arrels
programme.desc: Having played in New York with jazz icons Dave Liebman, Eliot Zigmund, Ari Hoenig, and Chris Cheek, Catalan bass player Manel Fortià now returns to his roots to reinvent traditional Catalan repertoire. Manel Fortià teams up with Antonia Lizana (saxophones), Pere Martínez (vocals), Max Villavecchia (piano), and Raphael Pannier (drums) to form ‘Libérica’, reimagining Catalan music and Flamenco through the eyes of a New York jazz musician.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Stift Festival: Suite del Ángel
programme.desc: Late August is traditionally the time for the annual Stift International Music Festival. Weerselo’s Stift Church and Oldenzaal’s ‘Hofkerk’ serve as venues for wonderful concerts of various young musicians from all over the world. The theme of the 2014 Stift Festival was “Divine and Demonic Passion”. Young musicians performed divine and demonic chamber music by composers such as Astor Piazzolla.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Portrait: North Sea Round Town
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: EU Jazz Competition
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Philippe Lemm Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Tango Extremo: Tango on the Tundra
programme.desc: Five musicians, in excess of 3000 miles, nine concerts, in thirteen days: in November 2015, the five-piece ensemble ‘Tango Extremo’ left the confines of its hometown, the Dutch city of The Hague, to travel through Russia. On the musicians’ jam-packed itinerary were performances in Moscow, Novosibirsk, Saratov, Tomsk, and Barnaul.

programme.title: Mezzoforte - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, famed Icelandic jazz fusion band Mezzoforte performed for over an hour at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Move Over
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: Recorda Me
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history.

programme.title: Live in Sydney
programme.desc: Steven Gene Wold, commonly known as Seasick Steve, (born circa 1941) is an American bluesman, although he prefers to be called 'a song and dance man'. He plays guitars (mostly personalized), and sings, usually about his early life living rough and doing casual work.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Diminuendo in Blue and Crescendo in Blue
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Adjustment
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Katie Melua
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: Live at Beck’s Festival Bar
programme.desc: The UK based band Metronomy started out as a bedroom project by Joseph Mount, who during its early stages was the sole contributor to the band's repertoire. After the debut release, Mount started expanding the band's personnel: first by adding two members, and later increasing it by one more.

programme.title: BIRD - The Nest
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project “The Nest”. Over the course of seven sessions, these talents exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together. Following this period, during which record producer Jameszoo and music manager Jochem Tromp offer their coaching experience, BIRD and North Sea Jazz Festival’s fringe festival DownTown organize a tryout performance.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Nardozza - Bisceglia
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Branford Marsalis Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, jazz saxophonist Branford Marsalis brought his band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 42
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features welterweights 'Sugar' Shane Mosley (43-4, 37 KOs) and Luis Collazo (27-2, 13 KOs) fighting over the interim WBC title. This fight took place at the Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on February 10, 2007.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 34
programme.desc: Wide World Of Fights includes all styles of fighting from around the world in one show! This episode features one of two encounters between Paul Williams and Sergio Martinez, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best judo of the World Team Championships from Budapest, where we will see history made as it's the first time a new mixed gender team format will be seen.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 24
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Danny Garcia looking to win the WBC super lightweight championship when he squares off with Erik Morales, but Garcia must battle back after suffering a nose injury early on. Also on the card, former world champions Hector Camacho and Adonis Stevenson.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T32 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 2 from Dolphins Areana in Nagoya, Japan features Hakuho, Meisei, Shodai and Takayasu.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Featuring Women's CMX Form and Weapons and Girl's Weapons at the ISKA US Open from Disney, Orlando, Florida, USA.

programme.title: MMA:30 T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: This episode features a look at how John Alessio, a MMA veteran of almost 20 years, prepares for an upcoming fight. We head inside the kitchen of one of MMA's leading nutritionists, Mike Dolce, to find out what are the approved foods in the Dolce Diet. Melvin Guillard summons his inner daredevil and jumps off the Stratosphere in Las Vegas, plus much more.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T1 - Ep. 58
programme.desc: Check out exciting action from MMA organizations around the world. This episode features coverage of mixed martial arts in South Africa including two fighters duke it out for the EFC Worldwide Middleweight Championship in Garreth 'Soldier Boy' McLellan vs. Dricus 'Stillknocks' Du Plessis. Bonus coverage includes Texier Kabesa vs. Luke Michael from Durban, South Africa.

programme.desc: Passionate lovers navigate a rollercoaster romance, facing euphoric highs and crushing lows while desperately clinging to their tumultuous bond.

programme.desc: In a dystopian future, relentless vigilante Ganapath embarks on a mission to dismantle a powerful criminal empire that rules the city in fear. Ganapath becomes a symbol of hope for the oppressed.

programme.title: Kuch Naa Kaho
programme.desc: A secretary's manager tells her to find a match for his nephew who does not want to get married. The nephew rejects every proposal and falls in love with the secretary instead.

programme.desc: Police conduct a raid on a house in Delhi, India, to search for terrorist suspects.

programme.title: Ek Chatur Naar
programme.desc: Struggling Mamta finds a corrupt tycoon's phone and risks everything by blackmailing him for a chance at a better life.

programme.desc: A woman seeks to escape her engagement to a violent politician, but when a stranger comes to her aid, the two face an onslaught of bigotry and hate.

programme.desc: Raj, Pooja and Jhanvi are in a complicated love triangle. Pooja and Jhanvi love Raj. Raj loves Jhanvi but is misunderstood as Pooja's husband by their family. How will the confusion clear off?.

programme.desc: An 80-year-old man with a penchant for real life games in a story about rights and wrongs.

programme.title: 12Th Fail

programme.title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
programme.desc: When a masked madman who wants to destroy India steals a dangerous weapon, two elite soldiers must work together to recover it.

programme.title: Jai Mummy Di
programme.desc: The trials and tribulations a couple has to undergo due to the dynamics between their respective mothers.

programme.title: Durgamati - The Myth
programme.desc: A bureaucrat is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

programme.desc: Após um período de temperaturas elevadas e poucos resgates, o chefe do reboque, Thord, suspira de alívio quando começa a nevar. Precisa de todo o trabalho que consiga angariar para manter o negócio sobre rodas.

programme.title: Resgate Abaixo De Zero T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: O desastre é frequentemente inevitável quando os camionistas internacionais tentam conduzir nas estradas da Noruega durante o Inverno. Boss Thord vai ajudar um deles. O condutor não conseguiu colocar as correntes corretamente e foi apanhado numa curva perigosa. Bjorn, o lobo solitário, vai com destino a uma situação semelhante. Bjorn fica chateado quando percebe que o condutor tentou subir um monte sem correntes.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 7
